text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
At last... someone has achieved it. The 
"Spring-Autumn Tenno Sho Double"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who seized two glories in the 
same year, from our very own Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady McQueen. I did it~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Two Shields for the Mejiro family... To 
think that someone like me, who used to be 
nothing but a burden, could make such a 
contribution...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Magnificent, Bright. However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I do not possess the right to sing 
your praises. After all, I... failed to 
see it through to the end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eh, demoted from 1st place to 18th!? How 
could this happen!?

text_block_list.name: Steward
text_block_list.text:
Impeding the course—because she greatly 
interfered with the running of another 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Steward
text_block_list.text:
—Right after the start on that corner, you 
cut sharply to the inside, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Steward
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it was unconscious, of course— 
but a ruling is a ruling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Because Tokyo's 2000m is just too... No 
way... How could..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My first Tenno Sho (Autumn). Too eager for 
glory, I had the strength to win, yet 
failed to keep my composure. Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this is the difference in our 
caliber. Even in the same circumstances, 
you managed to see it through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The difference... in our caliber...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, no~, Lady McQueen. This isn't a 
difference in character, but rather...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I believe it is simply a matter of turn 
order."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Take turns...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. I bore witness with my very 
own eyes. To Lady McQueen's challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And I inherited those experiences and that 
regret. Along with the noble desire to 
bring glory back to the Mejiro family at 
any cost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, today's consecutive victory 
isn't my triumph alone, but an 
'achievement' for the entire Mejiro 
family."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It was achieved together—by the 
generations of Mejiro Umamusume, Lady 
McQueen, and myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Bright... you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is true. You certainly could 
say that. And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To encourage me from such a grand 
perspective is yet another testament to 
your great caliber.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Bright. Thank you for 
clearing away my lingering regrets.

As a single Umamusume, and at the same 
time as a "successor of history," Mejiro 
Bright accomplished a great feat.
